story.title: 20 years of framing in the Lower Mainland
paragraphs: Surrey Framing has been framing homes across Surrey and the Lower Mainland for 20 years. In that time we have framed more than 200 projects: single-family homes, laneway houses and garden suites, additions and multi-family buildings.

We're a framing company and nothing else. That focus means our crew of 8–10 framers, labourers and apprentices spends every day on the same work: reading drawings, laying out, framing floors, walls and roofs, and getting frames ready for inspection.
The goal hasn't changed in 20 years: frames that are square, plumb and built to the drawings, finished on the schedule we agreed, on a site we're proud to hand over to the next trade.
Kimatpal Shergill owns and runs Surrey Framing. He brings more than 15 years of hands-on framing experience on new homes, additions and multi-family buildings across the Lower Mainland.

His experience covers every part of the job: reading engineered drawings, laying out walls, setting trusses and running a crew on a busy site. That is why the company works the way it does: plan carefully, check the drawings before building, and never leave a problem for the next trade to find.
Homeowners and builders who work with Surrey Framing deal with an owner who knows framing inside out and stands behind every frame the crew puts up.

areas.mapTitle: Map of Surrey and the Lower Mainland

cities.surrey: Surrey is home base. We frame across Fleetwood, Cloverdale, Newton, Guildford and South Surrey, from new single-family homes to coach houses on established lots and townhouse projects for local builders.
cities.langley: Langley's growth means a steady stream of new homes and townhouses, especially in Willoughby and Walnut Grove. We frame for builders on new subdivisions and for families adding suites and additions to older homes.
cities.delta: From Ladner and Tsawwassen to North Delta, we frame garden suites, additions and new homes. Many Delta lots have room for a backyard suite, and we plan each job so it doesn’t take over your yard.
cities.white-rock: White Rock's sloped lots and ocean views bring custom homes with tall walls, big windows and complex roofs. We frame to the engineered drawings and plan deliveries around tight streets and steep driveways.
cities.abbotsford: In Abbotsford we frame on new subdivisions and on larger rural and acreage lots, including family homes, detached shops and light commercial buildings.
cities.coquitlam: Coquitlam has new neighbourhoods on Burke Mountain alongside older homes ready for renovation. We frame new houses on sloped lots and open up main floors with new beams in existing homes.
cities.burnaby: Burnaby's single-family lots are turning into duplexes, fourplexes and multiplexes. We frame these small multi-unit buildings for builders and owners who need a crew that can keep pace.
cities.new-westminster: New Westminster has some of the region's oldest homes. Additions, second storeys and structural renovations in older houses need careful tie-ins to the existing frame, and that is the kind of work we do here.
cities.maple-ridge: Maple Ridge's newer areas, like Silver Valley, bring new homes on larger and sloped lots. We frame houses, garages and suites, often with vaulted ceilings and big roof spans.
cities.richmond: Richmond's flat lots see a steady mix of new homes, duplexes and townhouses. We frame to the engineered drawings and coordinate closely with builders on busy, tightly scheduled sites.

intro.title: Steady work with a crew that plans ahead
paragraphs: Surrey Framing has been framing homes in the Lower Mainland for 20 years. Our crew of 8–10 works on new homes, laneway houses, additions and multi-family buildings, mostly in Surrey and nearby cities.

We look for people who take pride in square, plumb work and look out for the people around them. Experienced framers get steady work and a well-run site. New people get real training from framers who know the trade.
